messageMap.purpose: The work itself: assembling wooden frames and sanding parts by hand, and seeing a finished product take shape
Training is provided, so you can start even without woodworking experience
The hourly wage is stated clearly at 1,400 yen
Weekdays only, 08:30 to 17:30 with a 60-minute break
Commuting costs are covered, up to 15,000 yen per month
